title: Hearty Crumbly Venezuelan Mixture Powder Empanadas
description: A quick-fix Venezuelan dish featuring mixture powder and lamination-puff, this empanada is citrusy and crumbly, perfect for a snack. It is jain-friendly and can be prepared in under an hour.

ingredients.name: mixture powder
ingredients.notes: available at most latin american markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the mixture powder, flour, and sugar.
Add the cold butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Stir in the orange zest and lime juice.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until it comes together.
Roll the dough out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Place a tablespoon of mixture powder in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with egg wash.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
